maps.name: 2024 Act 2 (SB8)
maps.description: 2024 special session congressional plan at issue in Callais.

maps.name: 2026 Act 2 (SB121)
maps.description: Separate 2026 regular session congressional plan signed May 29, 2026. The cited Supreme Court opinion did not adjudicate SB121.

cases.name: Louisiana v. Callais
cases.docket: U.S. Supreme Court 24-109 and 24-110; underlying W.D. La. 3:24-cv-00122
cases.summary: Supreme Court affirmed the judgment against the 2024 SB8 congressional map. Later lower court procedural status requires independent docket verification.

cases.name: Legislative action
cases.summary: Statutory map enactment, not a judicial decision.

events.title: District court rules against 2024 SB8 map
events.summary: Three judge federal district court found the 2024 map unconstitutional. The Supreme Court later stayed the injunction.

events.title: Supreme Court stays district court injunction
events.summary: The stay affected enforcement of the district court injunction while review proceeded. A stay is not a merits reversal.

events.title: Supreme Court affirms ruling against 2024 map
events.summary: The Court affirmed and remanded the ruling that SB8 was an unconstitutional racial gerrymander. The holding is about SB8, not the later SB121 map.

events.title: Governor signs SB121 as 2026 Act 2
events.summary: Louisiana enacted a distinct congressional plan. Any challenge to this plan must be documented with its own docket and order.
